class.name: OpenWorldPlacementEntry
class.brief_description: A weighted procedural content recipe used by World Placement.
class.description: An entry selects Tree, Vine, or Rock generation and supplies the matching reusable profile or request template. Optional [member trunk_material], [member foliage_material], [member stem_material], and [member preview_material] values are copied onto generated nodes during apply and rebuild. A preset may contain multiple entries of the same kind. Placement accepts [constant CONTENT_VINE] entries whose request mode is [constant OpenWorldVineGenerationRequest.MODE_BRAMBLE] (primary density) or [constant OpenWorldVineGenerationRequest.MODE_CREEPING] (vine density). Climbing, Hanging, and TreeWrap return [code]VINE_MODE_PHASE2[/code].

method.name: validate_entry
method.description: Returns a structured report containing [code]success[/code], [code]errors[/code], and [code]error_codes[/code].
